extraction: PYTHONUTF8=1; python combine.py create-db scowl.db; python -m libscowl word-list 70 B,Z 5 --categories= --wo-poses=abbr --wo-usage-notes=vulgar-1,vulgar-2,vulgar-3,offensive-1,offensive-2,offensive-3; retain lowercase ASCII [a-z]{5}, sort unique
curation: Common everyday family-appropriate British-English answer shortlist intersected with guesses. Broader upstream British guess list excludes labelled vulgar/offensive entries; labels are not exhaustive. No NYT data.
